description:

transcript:
Find the B in Find Tuning, Refining a Junket, Find Tuning the Shire.  
In the file, Refining a Junket, or in the 2D or 3D window where you drag and drop it,  
in the 2D toolbar, select Adjust Boarding Tools.  
Empty Select Boarding Tools.  
In the property editor, reduce the particle diameter of the board to 10.  
Press the Return key to confirm.  
Activate Simulation.  
Turn off Simulation after Simulation is completed.  
Adjust the Junket to make it fit the model.  
Use the Position Tool to tilt the board forward.  
If you tilt all the boards forward,  
the Shire may hang on the arm of the virtual model,  
instead of wrapping around the virtual model.  
To avoid this situation,  
just select the Junket and use the Position Tool to tilt the board forward.  
In the 3D window, change the view to the left view or the right view.  
If you want to switch to the left view, press 6.  
If you want to switch to the right view, press 4.  
Use the Position Tool to adjust the board.  
Tilt the board forward slightly.  
Be careful not to move the Junket away from the model.  
Activate Simulation.  
Turn off Simulation after Simulation is completed.  
To fine-tune some details of the Junket,  
select the Move Tool in the 3D toolbar.  
Gently pull the costume according to the simulation form.  
Adjust it to make the costume fit the model.  
Turn the wantingSide of the mold inside out.  
Return the Junket to its original position.  
Use the Plot Tool to fix the Junket.  
Click the register button to save the 24 hours.  
Press the left Relax button to move the Junket.  
Then pull the Junket.  
You have just arrived at the W Angle.  
Continue.  
穿在模特身上 (Put on the model)  
When the costume is adjusted, delete all the pins by pressing Ctrl + W on the keyboard to remove all the pins.  
In the 3D window, rotate the virtual model to confirm the jacket and wear it together on the virtual model.  
In the 3D window, set the size of the team.  
Then, the model is cut.  
Freestyle.  
Click on the model, select the model, and press Ctrl + W to cancel the creation.  
Click the model and press Ctrl + W to Dog.  
The model is ready to be changed as you want in the visual environment.  
Click the model and press Ctrl + W to clear the selection.  
Click the model and press Ctrl + W to confirm; the model is ready to use in the visual environment.

chunks.title: [CCTV Subtitled Dubbing] CLO Official Tutorial Video ~ Fine-tuning Part p03 3. Fine-tuning the Outer Layer of a Jacket
chunks.content: ## Fine-tuning the Outer Layer of a Jacket in CLO: Overview This section explains the detailed process of fine-tuning the outer layer (referred to as the "Junket") of a jacket in CLO, focusing on using tools like the Adjust Boarding Tool, Position Tool, Move Tool, and simulation controls. It covers how to properly position, simulate, and fit the garment on a virtual model while avoiding common issues such as fabric hanging incorrectly. --- ## Adjusting the Boarding Tools and Initial Junket Setup - Open the file named **Refining a Junket**. - In either the 2D or 3D window, drag and drop the garment piece (Junket). - Select **Adjust Boarding Tools** from the 2D toolbar. - In the property editor, reduce the **particle diameter** of the board to **10** and press **Return** to confirm. - Activate **Simulation** to see the initial garment behavior. - After the simulation completes, turn off Simulation. This step prepares the garment for fine-tuning by adjusting particle size, which affects cloth physics simulation, and positioning the garment pieces roughly on the model. --- ## Positioning the Junket with the Position Tool - Use the **Position Tool** to tilt the board forward slightly. - Avoid tilting all boards forward simultaneously, as this may cause the Junket to hang on the arm of the virtual model instead of wrapping properly. - Instead, select the Junket individually and tilt it forward carefully. - Change the 3D window view to the **left** or **right** side by pressing **6** (left view) or **4** (right view). - Adjust the board’s position from these side views to ensure proper fit without moving the garment away from the model. - Activate Simulation again to observe garment drape and behavior. - Turn off Simulation once the garment settles into the desired position. The careful adjustment in side views helps prevent unnatural fabric behavior and ensures the garment fits smoothly on the virtual model. --- ## Fine-tuning Details with the Move Tool and Plot Tool - Select the **Move Tool** in the 3D toolbar to modify specific garment areas. - Gently pull and adjust the Junket to follow the simulated cloth form more closely. - Turn the wanting side of the mold inside out if necessary to correct fit issues, then return the Junket to its original position. - Use the **Plot Tool** to fix the Junket’s position where needed. - Click the **register** button to save the adjustments (noted as "saving the 24 hours," likely meaning a save checkpoint). - Use the **Relax** function (left Relax button) to smooth out the garment and further pull the Junket to achieve the desired angle (referred to as the **W Angle**). This process ensures detailed garment fitting by manually correcting problem areas based on simulation feedback. --- ## Finalizing the Jacket Fit on the Virtual Model - Once adjustments are complete, remove all pins from the garment by pressing **Ctrl + W**.

chunks.content: - Click the **register** button to save the adjustments (noted as "saving the 24 hours," likely meaning a save checkpoint). - Use the **Relax** function (left Relax button) to smooth out the garment and further pull the Junket to achieve the desired angle (referred to as the **W Angle**). This process ensures detailed garment fitting by manually correcting problem areas based on simulation feedback. --- ## Finalizing the Jacket Fit on the Virtual Model - Once adjustments are complete, remove all pins from the garment by pressing **Ctrl + W**. - Rotate the virtual model in the 3D window to visually confirm the jacket fits well and is worn properly. - Adjust the model size settings as needed; this may involve cutting or modifying the model to match the garment fit. - To clear any selections or cancel operations, repeatedly use **Ctrl + W** on the model as appropriate. - Confirm the model is ready for use in the visual environment by ensuring all adjustments and clearances are finalized. This final step validates the garment fit and prepares the model and garment for further design or visualization tasks in CLO. --- ## Summary of Key Tools and Commands | Tool / Command | Function | |-----------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | Adjust Boarding Tools | Modify particle diameter and initial garment board settings | | Position Tool | Tilt and move garment pieces to fit the model, especially from side views (keys 4 and 6) | | Simulation | Activate and deactivate cloth simulation to observe garment behavior | | Move Tool | Fine-tune and pull garment to match simulation form | | Plot Tool | Fix the garment position after adjustments | | Relax Button | Smooth and relax garment fit after pulling | | Ctrl + W | Remove pins, clear selections, cancel operations, and finalize garment/model settings | This table consolidates the essential tools and shortcuts used throughout the fine-tuning process.
